2718694633.name: Emberfold
2718694633.description: A mill village in a fold of the hills, where the water runs all year.

npcs.name: Orin Vane
npcs.appearance: Floury to the elbow, and does not stop working to talk.
npcs.persona: Not sorry. Explains himself as though it were obvious.
knows: The rota put his beacon on the two nights his mill has to run.

npcs.name: Sabra Vane
npcs.appearance: Orin's sister, running the mill while he does not.

npcs.name: Corr Ableth
npcs.appearance: Loading meal onto a cart that is already full.
npcs.persona: Carries things and gossip in equal measure.

hooks: The mill runs two nights of the year it should not have to.

2730798778.name: Salt Wick
2730798778.description: A shore village of tarred roofs, its smokehouse the biggest thing in it.

npcs.name: Hebbel Marchen
npcs.appearance: Broad, grey-braided, with a tally-board of her own she never writes on.
npcs.persona: Speaks to be overheard. Will not accuse anybody without a thing in her hand.
knows: The beacon on Cairnhead did not light two nights ago.
The smokehouse was robbed the same night.

npcs.name: Wend Sallow
npcs.appearance: Smoke-cured himself, and short with anybody who doubts him.
npcs.persona: Certain about what he saw and tired of saying it.
knows: A boat put in below the headland that night, low in the water.

npcs.name: Tarrow Feld
npcs.appearance: Mending the same net he was mending yesterday.
npcs.persona: Talks about the watch the way people talk about weather.

npcs.name: Ithy Marchen
npcs.appearance: The reeve's cousin, and says so in the first sentence.
npcs.persona: Would rather the tally stayed away.

npcs.name: Dolm Rees
npcs.appearance: Sizing up timber that is not his.
npcs.persona: Noticed the new-cut wood and has not said so.

hooks: Nobody here will say whose turn it was.

3476876987.name: Hollowgate
3476876987.description: Two roofs and a byre where the valley road bends, kept open for people walking it.

npcs.name: Mabb Hollow
npcs.appearance: Standing in the road because that is where the custom is.
npcs.persona: Remembers everybody who has walked past, and says so unprompted.
knows: A man went south past here in a hurry, carrying a stick like a tally.

hooks: Everyone going south stops here, and everyone going south is remembered.

4230091797.name: Cairnhead
4230091797.description: Four roofs under the beacon path, and a cairn of split wood above them.

npcs.name: Nesh Cairnhead
npcs.appearance: Wind-burnt, in a coat too big for her, standing where she can see the sea.
npcs.persona: Answers exactly what is asked and nothing beside it.
knows: A man with a tally of his own told her the rota had changed.
The wood on the cairn has never been lit.

npcs.name: Bel Cairnhead
npcs.appearance: Nesh's brother, half her age and twice as talkative.
npcs.persona: Repeats what his sister says, badly.

hooks: The wood is dry and has never been lit.
